name: middleware-trpc
title: tRPC Middleware
description: tRPC middleware that annotates the ambient request wide event with trpc fields (pair with the Next.js route-handler wrapper).
docs: Wire into your procedure bases: `const amplioMiddleware = t.middleware(amplioTrpcMiddleware())` then `.use(amplioMiddleware)` on publicProcedure/protectedProcedure. In a create-t3-app layout, `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha init --wire` edits src/server/api/trpc.ts for you.
